modules.method: Paths with .pyc/.pyj removed; module presence only, no cross-format semantic equivalence.

native.method: Same/changed reflect directly fingerprinted shared native files only; other shared content remains unverified. Added/removed compare installed path presence.

inventory.method: Read-only manifests, installed fingerprints, ZIP CRC/member inventory and verified static payload headers; no client logic executed.

methodLimits: Resource/app equality is indexed MD5 and length; static payloads are separately content-checked.
Native same/changed counts cover only directly fingerprinted shared files; unverifiedShared is explicit.
An incomplete extraction is not evidence that its missing files were removed from that build.
Module presence does not establish activation; normalized Python comparisons are separate supplements.
